questions.stem: Which of the following describes the primary mechanism by which Angiopoietin-1 protects the glomerular filtration barrier and maintains glomerular endothelial cell integrity?

options.text: It binds to the Tie-2 receptor on glomerular endothelial cells, thereby reducing cellular apoptosis and preventing excessive permeability.
It competitively inhibits VEGF-A binding to VEGFR2 on podocytes, leading to the regression of fenestrations.
It directly polymerizes actin filaments in the slit diaphragm by recruiting N-WASP and the Arp2/3 complex.
It acts as a mechanical scaffold anchoring the podocyte foot processes directly to the glomerular basement membrane.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Podocyte 與 GEnCs 間的交互作用。Podocyte 會分泌 Angiopoietin-1，並與 GEnCs 上的 Tie-2 receptor 結合，此交互作用對於維持 GEnCs 的存活、減少 apoptosis 及防止過度通透性（excessive permeability）至關重要。

questions.stem: In the pathogenesis of minimal change disease (MCD), a specific form of Angiopoietin-like-4 (Angptl4) is implicated in the development of massive proteinuria. Which of the following forms is primarily responsible for this pathogenic effect?

options.text: Hyperglycosylated Angptl4 locally produced by glomerular endothelial cells.
Hyposialylated Angptl4 secreted by podocytes into the glomerular basement membrane.
Normosialylated Angptl4 released systematically from adipose tissue.
Phosphorylated Angptl4 stored within the slit diaphragm intracellular domain.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 MCD 蛋白尿發生的關鍵因子 Angiopoietin-like-4 (Angptl4)。在 Minimal Change Disease 中，Podocyte 會過度分泌 Hyposialylated Angptl4（低唾液酸化的 Angptl4）。這種異常型態的蛋白會導致 GBM 帶負電性降低，進而引發大量蛋白尿（proteinuria）。

questions.stem: A patient with metastatic renal cell carcinoma is treated with sunitinib. They subsequently develop new-onset severe proteinuria and hypertension, and a renal biopsy reveals thrombotic microangiopathy (TMA). The disruption of which of the following normal paracrine signaling pathways is most likely responsible for this presentation?

options.text: Endothelial CXCL12 binding to CXCR4 on mesangial cells.
Podocyte Angiopoietin-2 binding to Tie-1 on endothelial cells.
Podocyte VEGF-A binding to VEGFR2 on glomerular endothelial cells.
Endothelial PDGF-B binding to PDGFR-beta on podocytes.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 VEGF-A 在維持腎絲球內皮細胞（GEnCs）孔洞（fenestrations）與健康的重要性，以及抗血管新生藥物（Anti-VEGF therapy）的副作用。正常情況下，Podocyte 分泌 VEGF-A，結合並活化 GEnCs 上的 VEGFR2。當使用如 Bevacizumab 或 Sunitinib（VEGFR 抑制劑）阻斷此路徑時，會導致內皮細胞受損、微血管栓塞性病變（TMA）以及嚴重的蛋白尿。

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the role of the Stromal cell-derived factor-1 (SDF-1/CXCL12) pathway in the glomerular microenvironment?

options.text: SDF-1 binds to the CXCR4 receptor, facilitating essential crosstalk between podocytes and glomerular endothelial cells.
SDF-1 acts as a mechanosensor on the podocyte apical membrane, increasing calcium influx during elevated glomerular pressure.
SDF-1 competitively blocks Tie-2 receptors, inducing rapid apoptosis of glomerular endothelial cells.
SDF-1 forms the structural core of the slit diaphragm alongside nephrin and podocin.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Podocyte 與 GEnC 之間的 crosstalk 因子 SDF-1 (CXCL12)。SDF-1 會與其受體 CXCR4 結合，在腎絲球微環境中負責細胞間的信號傳遞，以維持細胞存活與功能穩定。

questions.stem: Mutations in the NPHS2 gene are a well-recognized cause of childhood steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome (SRNS). Which of the following structural characteristics defines the protein encoded by this gene?

options.text: It is a secreted dimeric glycoprotein that regulates capillary fenestrations.
It is an integral membrane protein with a classic hairpin-like topology that anchors nephrin.
It is a calcium-permeable non-selective cation channel located in the slit diaphragm.
It is an SH2 domain-containing adaptor protein that recruits actin-polymerizing complexes.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Podocin 的結構特徵與相關基因。NPHS2 基因編碼 Podocin，該蛋白具有獨特的髮夾狀（hairpin）跨膜拓樸結構（topology），它的 N 端與 C 端均位於細胞內，並藉由這個構型將 nephrin 固定於 Lipid raft 區域。NPHS2 突變是孩童類固醇抗拒型腎病症候群（SRNS）最常見的原因之一。

questions.stem: During slit diaphragm signaling, which of the following adaptor proteins binds directly to phosphorylated nephrin to recruit N-WASP and the Arp2/3 complex, driving local actin polymerization?

options.text: MAGI-1
CD2AP
TRPC6
Nck

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Slit-diaphragm 下游的 Actin 細胞骨架重塑機制。當 nephrin 受到 Fyn 激酶磷酸化後，會吸引包含 SH2 domain 的 Nck adaptor 蛋白結合。Nck 接著招募 N-WASP 以及 Arp2/3 complex，進而引發 actin polymerization，此過程對維持足突（foot process）的形態至關重要。

questions.stem: A 35-year-old patient presents with massive proteinuria and is diagnosed with adult-onset autosomal dominant focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS). Genetic testing reveals a gain-of-function mutation. This mutation most likely affects a protein responsible for which of the following processes?

options.text: Facilitating excessive intracellular calcium influx that leads to podocyte foot process effacement.
Reducing the production of sialic acid residues on angiopoietin-like-4.
Preventing the phosphorylation of nephrin by the Fyn tyrosine kinase.
Forming tight junction complexes in parallel with the MAGI-1 and JAM4 proteins.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 TRPC6 基因突變與 FSGS 的關係。TRPC6 是一個非選擇性陽離子通道（主要透鈣）。其 gain-of-function mutation 會導致細胞內鈣離子（calcium influx）異常升高，進而引發 actin 細胞骨架解聚與 podocyte effacement，臨床上表現為體染色體顯性遺傳（AD）的成人型 FSGS。

questions.stem: Within the complex intracellular network of the podocyte, how does the function of CD2AP distinguish itself from that of the MAGI-1/JAM4 complex?

options.text: CD2AP acts as a calcium channel, whereas MAGI-1/JAM4 are primarily responsible for actin polymerization.
CD2AP is an extracellular ligand for Tie-2, whereas MAGI-1/JAM4 act as intracellular kinases.
CD2AP acts as a scaffolding adapter linking nephrin/podocin to actin and PI3K/Akt signaling, whereas MAGI-1/JAM4 represent a distinct tight junction-like complex.
CD2AP forms the primary structural core of the glomerular basement membrane, whereas MAGI-1/JAM4 maintain the endothelial fenestrations.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 CD2AP 與 MAGI-1/JAM4 複合物的角色區別。CD2AP 是一個重要的 scaffolding adapter 蛋白，能夠將 nephrin 和 podocin 連結到 actin 細胞骨架，同時參與 PI3K/Akt 存活訊息傳遞路徑。相對地，MAGI-1 與 JAM4 則負責形成類似 tight junction 的複合體，有助於維持細胞間的連結穩定。

questions.stem: Glomerular endothelial cells (GEnCs) possess unique phenotypic characteristics crucial for the maintenance of the glomerular filtration barrier. Which of the following combinations of surface markers is most representative of mature, differentiated glomerular endothelial cells?

options.text: CD31 (PECAM-1), VEGFR2, and CD144 (VE-cadherin)
CD31 (PECAM-1), Nephrin, and Podocalyxin
VEGFR1, Synaptopodin, and CD146 (MCAM)
CD34, Alpha-smooth muscle actin, and Vimentin

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查成熟 Glomerular endothelial cells (GEnCs) 的表面標記。成熟的 GEnCs 表現出典型的內皮細胞標記，包含 CD31 (PECAM-1)、VEGFR2 (Vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 2) 以及 CD144 (VE-cadherin)。

questions.stem: Paracrine signaling between podocytes and glomerular endothelial cells (GEnCs) is essential for glomerular integrity. The maintenance of GEnC fenestrations is primarily dependent on which of the following molecular interactions?

options.text: GEnC-derived Angiopoietin-1 binding to podocyte Tie2 receptors
Podocyte-derived VEGF-A binding to GEnC VEGFR2
Podocyte-derived TGF-beta1 binding to GEnC ALK5 receptors
GEnC-derived PDGF-B binding to podocyte PDGFR-beta

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Podocyte 與 GEnC 之間的 crosstalk 及其對維持 fenestrations 的重要性。Podocyte 會持續分泌 VEGF-A (Vascular endothelial growth factor A)，其跨越 Glomerular basement membrane (GBM) 結合至 GEnC 上的 VEGFR2 受體。這條傳遞路徑對於維持 GEnC 的存活以及其特有的 fenestrations 結構是絕對必要的。

questions.stem: A 45-year-old patient presents with acute kidney injury, thrombocytopenia, and microangiopathic hemolytic anemia. Renal biopsy confirms thrombotic microangiopathy (TMA). During this acute endothelial injury, which of the following changes in glomerular endothelial cell (GEnC) marker expression is typically observed?

options.text: Downregulation of Tissue Factor and upregulation of Thrombomodulin
Complete loss of CD31 expression with de novo synthesis of Nephrin
Increased expression of von Willebrand factor (vWF) and ICAM-2
Upregulation of PV-1 and loss of integrin alpha-v beta-3

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查在內皮細胞損傷 (如 Thrombotic microangiopathy, TMA) 狀態下的 GEnC 標記變化。當 GEnCs 受到損傷或活化時，它們會大量表現促凝血與發炎相關的分子。其中，von Willebrand factor (vWF) 的表現與釋放會顯著增加，以促進血小板凝集；同時細胞黏附分子如 ICAM-2 亦會上調。

questions.stem: When distinguishing specialized glomerular endothelial cells (GEnCs) from other capillary endothelial cells in the body, researchers often analyze the expression of fenestration-associated proteins versus pan-endothelial markers. Which of the following correctly pairs a specialized fenestration-related marker with a standard pan-endothelial marker?

options.text: CD31 as a fenestration marker; VEGFR2 as a pan-endothelial marker
E-selectin as a fenestration marker; CD34 as a pan-endothelial marker
VE-cadherin as a fenestration marker; PV-1 (PLVAP) as a pan-endothelial marker
PV-1 (PLVAP) as a fenestration marker; CD31 as a pan-endothelial marker

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 GEnC 窗孔 (fenestration) 專一性標記與泛內皮 (pan-endothelial) 標記的區別。PV-1 (Plasmalemma vesicle-associated protein, PLVAP) 是一種與血管內皮細胞 fenestrations 及小窩 (caveolae) 高度相關的結構蛋白，在有孔內皮微血管中表現量較高。相對於此，CD31 (PECAM-1) 與 CD34 是全身血管內皮細胞廣泛表現的 pan-endothelial markers。

questions.stem: In the pathogenesis of diabetic nephropathy, maladaptive crosstalk between glomerular endothelial cells (GEnCs) and podocytes contributes to proteinuria. Increased production of which molecule by injured GEnCs directly acts on specific podocyte receptors to induce cytoskeletal rearrangement and foot process effacement?

options.text: Endothelin-1 acting on ETA receptors
VEGF-A acting on VEGFR1 receptors
Angiotensin II acting on AT2 receptors
Nitric oxide acting on soluble guanylate cyclase

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Diabetic nephropathy 中 GEnC 與 Podocyte 的病理性 crosstalk。在糖尿病腎病變的早期，受損的 GEnC 會增加 Endothelin-1 (ET-1) 的分泌。這些由內皮細胞來源的 ET-1 透過旁分泌機制 (paracrine) 作用於 Podocyte 上的 Endothelin A (ETA) receptors，導致 Podocyte 細胞骨架重塑 (cytoskeletal rearrangement)、足突融合 (foot process effacement) 以及隨後的蛋白尿。

questions.stem: During the early stages of diabetic kidney disease, compensatory mechanisms attempt to regulate excessive pro-angiogenic signals. Which of the following molecules is produced by glomerular endothelial cells (GEnCs) serving as a negative feedback regulator to counteract VEGF-induced abnormal angiogenesis?

options.text: Endostatin
Vasohibin-1
Thrombospondin-1
Angiopoietin-2

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查對抗 VEGF 誘導性血管新生 (angiogenesis) 的負回饋調節因子。Vasohibin-1 (VASH1) 是由 GEnCs 所產生的一種內源性抗血管生成因子 (anti-angiogenic factor)。在受到 VEGF-A 刺激後，GEnCs 會表現並分泌 VASH1，以負回饋機制 (negative feedback) 抑制過度或異常的血管新生，藉此維持微血管網的穩定。

questions.stem: A patient with long-standing type 2 diabetes mellitus develops significant albuminuria. Experimental studies on similar diabetic models suggest that the loss of glomerular charge selectivity is partially driven by enzymatic degradation of the endothelial glycocalyx and glomerular basement membrane (GBM). Which enzyme, primarily secreted by stressed podocytes, is responsible for degrading heparan sulfate in these structures?

options.text: Matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9)
Hyaluronidase-1
Heparanase
Cathepsin L

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) 中電荷選擇性 (charge selectivity) 喪失的分子機制。在 DKD 環境下，處於壓力狀態的 Podocytes 會大量分泌 Heparanase (乙醯肝素酶)。Heparanase 會降解 Glomerular basement membrane (GBM) 與內皮細胞表面 Glycocalyx 中的 Heparan sulfate (一種富含負電荷的蛋白聚醣)，導致腎絲球過濾屏障的負電荷流失，進而引起白蛋白尿 (albuminuria)。

questions.stem: Novel therapeutic strategies for proteinuric kidney diseases, including IgA nephropathy and focal segmental glomerulosclerosis, utilize dual or selective receptor antagonism. Drugs such as sparsentan and atrasentan primarily reduce proteinuria and protect podocyte structure by targeting which of the following mechanisms?

options.text: Activation of the GLP-1 receptor to enhance insulin sensitivity
Inhibition of the mineralocorticoid receptor to reduce fibrosis
Antagonism of the ETB receptor to promote vasodilation
Antagonism of the ETA receptor to block endothelin-1 mediated podocyte injury

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Endothelin receptor antagonists 在蛋白尿腎病變中的作用機轉。Sparsentan (具有 dual ETA/Angiotensin II type 1 receptor antagonism) 與 Atrasentan (selective ETA receptor antagonist) 主要是透過拮抗 ETA receptor 來發揮作用。阻斷 ETA receptor 可以防止由內皮細胞來源的 Endothelin-1 對 Podocyte 造成的骨架破壞與足突融合，從而達到保護 Podocyte 結構並有效降低蛋白尿的臨床效益。

questions.stem: A 45-year-old male with a 10-year history of type 2 diabetes mellitus presents for a routine check-up. His estimated glomerular filtration rate is 95 mL/min/1.73 m2, and a standard urine dipstick is negative for protein. However, his physician suspects early diabetic nephropathy. Which of the following urinary biomarkers is derived from the apical membrane of podocytes and is considered one of the earliest indicators of podocyte injury, often appearing prior to the onset of clinical microalbuminuria?

options.text: Nephrin
Neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin
Podocalyxin
Kidney injury molecule-1

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Podocyte injury 的早期生物標記。Podocalyxin 是一種位於 Podocyte (足細胞) apical membrane (頂端膜) 的跨膜糖蛋白。在糖尿病腎病變 (Diabetic nephropathy) 等疾病的極早期，當足細胞受到損傷時，Podocalyxin 會脫落進入尿液中。研究顯示，urinary Podocalyxin shedding 的發生時間往往早於 microalbuminuria (微量白蛋白尿) 的出現，因此被認為是偵測早期腎絲球損傷的極佳 biomarker。

questions.stem: A 52-year-old female with focal segmental glomerulosclerosis is being monitored for disease progression. Researchers are analyzing her urine sediment to estimate the rate of ongoing podocyte loss. The urinary excretion rate of which of the following directly correlates most strongly with the development of progressive glomerulosclerosis?

options.text: Viable podocyte count
Tamm-Horsfall protein
Uromodulin fragments
Secreted phospholipase A2 receptor

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Podocyte loss 與 glomerulosclerosis (腎絲球硬化) 之間的關聯性。Podocyte 屬於高度分化的終末細胞，缺乏顯著的再生能力。當 Podocyte 受損並從 glomerular basement membrane (GBM) 脫落時，可以透過測量尿液中的 viable podocyte count (活足細胞數量) 或 podocyte excretion rate 來量化損傷程度。這個 excretion rate 與進行性的 glomerulosclerosis 及腎功能的惡化具有高度的直接相關性。

questions.stem: In the evaluation of early diabetic nephropathy, a temporal relationship exists between structural podocyte damage and the development of abnormal proteinuria. When comparing the appearance of urinary biomarkers, which of the following statements most accurately describes the timeline of biomarker sensitivity?

options.text: Microalbuminuria (AER 30-300 mg/day) uniformly precedes any detectable shedding of podocyte-specific proteins.
Urinary nephrin levels peak only after macroalbuminuria (>300 mg/day) has been established for several months.
An isolated elevation in urinary albumin creatinine ratio (UACR) occurs independently of early podocyte architectural changes.
Significant urinary shedding of podocalyxin can be detected prior to the transition from normoalbuminuria to an albumin excretion rate of 30-300 mg/day.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Albumin Excretion Rate (AER) 與 Podocalyxin 敏感度的時間軸關係。傳統上使用 microalbuminuria (AER 30-300 mg/day) 作為糖尿病腎病變的早期指標，但近期的證據顯示，Podocyte 的結構改變及頂端膜蛋白的脫落發生得更早。因此，urinary shedding of Podocalyxin (尿液中足萼蛋白脫落) 可以在 normoalbuminuria (正常白蛋白尿，AER < 30 mg/day) 階段、尚未進展至 microalbuminuria 之前就被偵測到，具備更高的早期敏感度。

questions.stem: A renal biopsy from a patient with advanced chronic kidney disease reveals extensive areas of global glomerulosclerosis. Current pathophysiological paradigms emphasize the critical role of specific cellular loss in this irreversible process. Which of the following mechanisms is considered a primary, irreversible driver initiating and promoting focal or global glomerulosclerosis?

options.text: Endothelial cell hyperproliferation
Absolute podocyte depletion leading to denudation of the glomerular basement membrane
Mesangial cell apoptosis causing expansion of the Bowman's space
Parietal epithelial cell dedifferentiation into mature functioning podocytes

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Podocyte depletion (足細胞耗竭) 概念。在腎絲球疾病進展的病理機制中，Podocyte depletion 被認為是推動 glomerulosclerosis (腎絲球硬化) 的核心、不可逆驅動因素。當足細胞數量減少超過一定閾值 (如 20-40%)，會導致 glomerular basement membrane (GBM) 出現 denudation (裸露區)，隨後引發 parietal epithelial cells 的異常增生與細胞外基質沉積，最終形成 synechiae (黏連) 及 focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS)。

questions.stem: A 65-year-old male undergoes complex cardiovascular surgery and subsequently develops oliguria and rising serum creatinine, consistent with ischemic acute kidney injury. A novel urinary biomarker is measured which is known to be a cytoplasmic protein of the proximal tubule, upregulated specifically in response to ischemic and oxidative stress. Which of the following is this biomarker?

options.text: Liver-type fatty acid-binding protein (L-FABP)
Insulin-like growth factor-binding protein 7 (IGFBP7)
Tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinases-2 (TIMP-2)
Cystatin C

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 proximal tubule injury (近端小管損傷) 的生物標記。Liver-type fatty acid-binding protein (L-FABP) 是一種存在於 proximal tubule (近端小管) 細胞質中的蛋白質。在缺血 (ischemic) 或氧化壓力 (oxidative stress) 下，L-FABP 的基因表現會被顯著 upregulation (上調)，以促進游離脂肪酸的代謝，並隨後釋放到尿液中。因此，尿液 L-FABP 是偵測急性腎損傷 (AKI) 早期缺血性壓力的優良 biomarker。

questions.stem: In experimental models of ischemia-reperfusion injury in the kidney, a specific neuroimmune guidance cue is shown to be markedly upregulated in proximal tubule cells and subsequently excreted in the urine. This molecule is virtually undetectable in normal kidneys but serves as an early biomarker for acute kidney injury. Which of the following molecules fits this description?

options.text: Osteopontin
Interleukin-18
Calprotectin
Netrin-1

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Netrin-1 作為 AKI 的生物標記。Netrin-1 最初被認為是神經發育過程中的導引蛋白 (guidance cue)，但在正常的腎臟中幾乎偵測不到。然而，在經歷 ischemia-reperfusion injury (缺血再灌注損傷) 或其他形式的急性腎損傷 (AKI) 後，Netrin-1 在 proximal tubule cells (近端小管細胞) 中會發生顯著的 upregulation (上調)，並迅速釋放到尿液中，使其成為評估早期 AKI 的高度敏感 biomarker。

questions.stem: A 40-year-old patient exposed to heavy metals is evaluated for suspected proximal tubular dysfunction. A 24-hour urine collection reveals elevated levels of a specific low-molecular-weight protein that is normally freely filtered at the glomerulus and nearly completely reabsorbed and catabolized by healthy proximal tubule cells. Which of the following proteins is the most appropriate marker for this isolated tubulopathy?

options.text: Immunoglobulin G
Transferrin
Alpha-1-microglobulin (A1M)
Fibronectin

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 tubulopathy (小管病變) 的標記。α1-Microglobulin (A1M) 是一種 low-molecular-weight protein (低分子量蛋白質)，正常生理狀態下可自由通過腎絲球過濾 (filtered at glomerulus)，接著在 proximal tubules (近端小管) 被幾乎完全 reabsorbed (再吸收) 並分解代謝。當近端小管功能受損 (例如重金屬中毒引起的 tubulopathy) 時，A1M 無法被有效再吸收，導致其在尿液中的濃度顯著升高。

questions.stem: A 55-year-old patient admitted to the intensive care unit with severe sepsis develops acute tubular necrosis. Analysis of the patient's urine shows elevated levels of a proinflammatory cytokine that is synthesized in the proximal tubules as an inactive precursor and is cleaved into its active form by caspase-1 during ischemic injury. Which of the following cytokines is described?

options.text: Interleukin-6
Interleukin-18
Tumor necrosis factor-alpha
Transforming growth factor-beta

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 IL-18 在急性腎損傷中的角色。Interleukin-18 (IL-18) 是一種 proinflammatory cytokine (促發炎細胞激素)。在腎臟中，它由 proximal tubules (近端小管) 合成，最初為不具活性的前驅物 (inactive precursor)。當遭遇 ATN (急性肺管壞死) 或 ischemic AKI (缺血性急性腎損傷) 時，細胞內的 caspase-1 會活化，將 IL-18 裂解 (cleaved) 為活性形式，隨後脫落 (shed) 進入尿液中，成為診斷 AKI 的重要早期生物標記。

questions.stem: A 55-year-old male with type 2 diabetes and early-stage diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is evaluated for his long-term risk of progression to end-stage renal disease (ESRD). Recent studies have investigated various circulating biomarkers to predict renal function decline independently of albuminuria. Which of the following biomarkers is most strongly associated with both interstitial fibrosis and long-term risk of ESRD in patients with DKD?

options.text: Soluble tumor necrosis factor receptors 1 and 2 (sTNFR1 and sTNFR2)
Urinary neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin (NGAL)
Fibroblast growth factor 23 (FGF23)
High-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP)

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Diabetic Kidney Disease (DKD) 進展中預測 Interstitial fibrosis 和 ESRD risk 的 biomarker。Soluble TNFR1 (sTNFR1) 和 sTNFR2 在 serum 和 urine 中的升高，與 DKD 患者的長期 ESRD risk 以及 interstitial fibrosis 有強烈的預測關聯，獨立於傳統的 albuminuria 和 eGFR 變化。

questions.stem: Interstitial fibrosis is a final common pathway for progressive chronic kidney disease. A key cytokine drives this process by promoting phenotypic changes in fibroblasts and stimulating the excessive synthesis of extracellular matrix components, notably type IV collagen and fibronectin, while simultaneously inhibiting matrix degradation. Which of the following is the primary profibrotic cytokine mediating this process?

options.text: Interleukin-6 (IL-6)
Transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-β)
Vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF)
Tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α)

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查驅動 Interstitial fibrosis 的核心細胞因子。Transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-β) 是最主要的 profibrotic cytokine，它促使 fibroblast 活化與增生，並大量增加 Extracellular matrix (ECM)，如 type IV collagen 和 fibronectin 的合成，同時抑制 matrix degradation。

questions.stem: A clinical trial is investigating non-invasive diagnostic tools to assess the activity of renal fibrogenesis in patients with chronic kidney disease, aiming to replace serial kidney biopsies. The researchers are focusing on measuring fragments of extracellular matrix proteins in the urine. Which of the following biomarkers best serves as a direct indicator of active type IV collagen turnover and ongoing interstitial fibrogenesis?

options.text: Urinary alpha-1 microglobulin
Urinary kidney injury molecule-1 (KIM-1)
Urinary pro-collagen IV fragments
Urinary epidermal growth factor (EGF)

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題探討 CKD 進行中代表 active fibrogenesis 的非侵入性 biomarker。Urinary pro-collagen IV fragments 是 active fibrogenesis 和 Extracellular matrix turnover 的直接產物，因此可作為評估 interstitial fibrosis 活躍程度的 non-invasive biomarker。

questions.stem: Tubulointerstitial scarring results from an imbalance between the synthesis and degradation of the extracellular matrix (ECM). Matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) are enzymes primarily responsible for ECM degradation. In the pathogenesis of progressive chronic kidney disease, which of the following mechanisms best explains the contribution of the MMP system to the excessive accumulation of ECM?

options.text: Upregulation of MMP-2 directly stimulates collagen synthesis by resident macrophages.
Excessive activation of all MMP isoforms leads to compensatory overproduction of ECM by mesangial cells.
A primary genetic defect in MMP-9 synthesis causes rapid interstitial fibrosis in all early-stage CKD patients.
Increased expression of tissue inhibitors of metalloproteinases (TIMPs) suppresses MMP activity, reducing ECM degradation.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Extracellular matrix (ECM) turnover 及 matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) 抑制在 tubulointerstitial scarring 的機制。在進行性 CKD 中，Tissue inhibitors of metalloproteinases (TIMPs) 的表現量增加，這會強烈抑制 MMPs 的活性，導致 ECM degradation 下降，進而促進 interstitial fibrosis。

questions.stem: A 62-year-old critically ill patient is admitted to the intensive care unit with septic shock. To assess the patient's short-term risk of developing moderate-to-severe acute kidney injury (AKI), a combination biomarker test is ordered. The test measures proteins associated with G1 cell cycle arrest. Which of the following correctly identifies the biomarkers involved and their predictive timeframe?

options.text: TIMP-2 and IGFBP-7, predicting AKI within 12 hours
NGAL and Cystatin-C, predicting AKI within 48 hours
IL-18 and KIM-1, predicting AKI within 24 hours
TIMP-1 and TGF-β, predicting AKI within 72 hours

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查預測重症病患早期 AKI 的 biomarker (NephroCheck)。TIMP-2 (Tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinases-2) 和 IGFBP-7 (Insulin-like growth factor-binding protein 7) 是 G1 cell cycle arrest 的標記物，當腎小管細胞受到壓力或損傷時會釋放，可高度預測 12 小時內發生 moderate-to-severe AKI 的風險。

questions.stem: Neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin (NGAL) has emerged as a promising early biomarker for acute kidney injury. After an ischemic or toxic insult to the kidneys, which of the following best describes the physiological origin and timing of NGAL upregulation in the nephron?

options.text: It is slowly synthesized over 48 hours primarily by the macula densa.
It is an acute-phase protein rapidly upregulated in the distal nephron within a few hours.
It is exclusively secreted by injured podocytes within minutes of an insult.
It is released from the juxtaglomerular apparatus due to renin depletion.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 NGAL (neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin) 作為 AKI biomarker 的特性。NGAL 屬於 lipocalin family，是一種 acute-phase protein。在發生缺血或毒性損傷後，它會在幾個小時內迅速被 distal nephron (遠端腎單位) 的細胞大量表達與分泌，使其成為極早期的 AKI 標記物。

questions.stem: The "creatinine-blind window" refers to the delay in serum creatinine elevation during early acute kidney injury (AKI), despite a significant drop in glomerular filtration rate (GFR). An alternative endogenous biomarker has been proposed to detect early GFR changes more reliably because its production is constant and it is freely filtered and fully reabsorbed without secretion. Which of the following biomarkers fits this physiological profile?

options.text: Uromodulin
Interleukin-18 (IL-18)
Serum Cystatin-C
Kidney injury molecule-1 (KIM-1)

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查克服 "creatinine-blind window" 的早期 GFR marker。Serum Cystatin-C 由所有有核細胞 (nucleated cells) 以恆定速率產生，經腎小球自由濾過 (freely filtered)，並在 proximal tubule 被完全重吸收與分解，不被分泌回管腔。因此，當 GFR 早期下降時，血清 Cystatin-C 的上升速度與靈敏度優於 creatinine。

questions.stem: A comparative analysis of various acute kidney injury (AKI) biomarkers is being conducted to evaluate their distinct pathophysiological roles. While NGAL and IL-18 reflect structural tubular injury and Cystatin-C reflects early changes in glomerular filtration rate, another set of biomarkers indicates tubular cellular stress prior to frank damage. Which of the following biomarkers primarily functions as an indicator of cellular stress through cell cycle arrest?

options.text: Interleukin-18 (IL-18)
Urinary output volume
Serum creatinine
TIMP-2 and IGFBP-7

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Multi-biomarker panel 在 AKI 診斷中的不同意義。TIMP-2 和 IGFBP-7 參與 G1 cell cycle arrest，代表細胞在發生實質壞死或結構損傷 (frank damage) 之前的 cellular stress 反應。相較之下，NGAL, IL-18, KIM-1 等反映的是已發生的 structural tubular injury，而 Cystatin-C 和 Creatinine 則反映 functional GFR changes。

questions.stem: A 22-year-old male presents with advanced chronic kidney disease and a family history of renal failure. Genetic testing reveals compound heterozygous mutations in the COL4A3 gene. Which of the following statements best describes the prognostic implications of his genetic diagnosis compared to patients with an autosomal dominant form of this disease?

options.text: His risk of progressing to end-stage renal disease is significantly lower than that of patients with heterozygous COL4A3 mutations.
Autosomal dominant inheritance typically leads to earlier onset of end-stage renal disease compared to his specific genetic profile.
He is at a substantially higher risk of developing end-stage renal disease in young adulthood compared to patients with an autosomal dominant transmission pattern.
His prognosis is identical to that of an individual possessing a single mutated copy of the COL4A4 gene.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Alport syndrome 中 Autosomal Recessive (AR) 與 Autosomal Dominant (AD) 的 ESRD 風險差異。AR Alport syndrome 通常由 COL4A3 或 COL4A4 的 homozygous 或 compound heterozygous 突變引起，其病程進展較快，多數病患在年輕成年期（young adulthood）即進展至 End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD)。相對地，AD 遺傳模式（heterozygous COL4A3/A4 突變）的病程較為溫和（milder）。

questions.stem: A nephrologist is counseling a family with a history of microscopic hematuria and progressive renal decline. Whole exome sequencing is performed on a 30-year-old female patient and her symptomatic father. Which of the following genotypes most accurately differentiates autosomal recessive from autosomal dominant Alport syndrome?

options.text: Autosomal recessive disease is caused by heterozygous mutations in COL4A5, whereas autosomal dominant disease requires homozygous mutations in COL4A3.
Autosomal dominant Alport syndrome is characterized by compound heterozygous mutations in COL4A4, leading to complete absence of the alpha-4 chain.
Both autosomal dominant and autosomal recessive forms involve the exact same heterozygous mutation in COL4A3 but differ only in environmental penetrance.
Autosomal recessive Alport syndrome requires homozygous or compound heterozygous mutations in COL4A3 or COL4A4, whereas the autosomal dominant form is caused by heterozygous mutations in these genes.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Alport syndrome 的基因型特徵。Autosomal Recessive (AR) Alport syndrome 需要 COL4A3 或 COL4A4 基因呈現 homozygous 或 compound heterozygous 突變；而 Autosomal Dominant (AD) 模式則是由 COL4A3 或 COL4A4 的 heterozygous 突變所引起。COL4A5 突變則是導致 X-linked Alport syndrome 的原因。

questions.stem: A 15-year-old boy is evaluated for persistent hematuria and proteinuria. A renal biopsy suggests a hereditary nephritis. Ophthalmic examination reveals anterior lenticonus, and audiometry confirms high-frequency sensorineural hearing loss. Genetic analysis identifies a mutation in the COL4A5 gene. Which of the following statements regarding the correlation between genetics and clinical presentation in Alport syndrome is most accurate?

options.text: X-linked Alport syndrome accounts for the majority of cases and is strongly associated with extra-renal manifestations such as sensorineural hearing loss and anterior lenticonus, whereas autosomal dominant cases rarely exhibit severe ocular anomalies.
Mutations in the COL4A5 gene typically produce isolated renal failure without any associated ophthalmic or auditory defects.
Autosomal dominant Alport syndrome is the most common subtype and has the highest prevalence of macular dots and anterior lenticonus.
Sensorineural hearing loss is exclusively observed in autosomal recessive Alport syndrome, effectively ruling out an X-linked transmission pattern.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Alport syndrome 的基因分型與腎外表現（extra-renal manifestations）。X-linked Alport syndrome 最為常見（約佔 80%），由 COL4A5 突變引起，且常伴隨明顯的腎外表現，如 sensorineural hearing loss、anterior lenticonus 及 macular dots。相較之下，Autosomal Dominant (AD) 的病程較為溫和。

questions.stem: A renal biopsy from a 25-year-old male with progressive kidney disease reveals a characteristic basket-weave appearance of the glomerular basement membrane on electron microscopy. Which of the following pathophysiological mechanisms directly leads to this ultrastructural abnormality?

options.text: Excessive deposition of organized immune complexes within the lamina densa, severely disrupting normal podocyte architecture.
The absence of the normal alpha-3, alpha-4, and alpha-5 type IV collagen network, which is subsequently replaced by the less stable alpha-1 and alpha-2 type IV collagen network.
A primary defect in the synthesis of type III collagen, leading to compensatory but irregular overproduction of type I collagen fibrils within the glomerular basement membrane.
Overexpression of the alpha-5 type IV collagen chain, resulting in hyper-crosslinking and subsequent rigid thickening of the capillary loops.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Alport syndrome 於電子顯微鏡（EM）下的典型表現及其分子機制。正常的 Glomerular Basement Membrane (GBM) 依賴由 type IV collagen 的 α3α4α5 鏈構成的強韌網狀結構。在 Alport syndrome 中，此網路因基因突變缺失，代償性被較不穩定的 α1α1α2 網路（胚胎期主要結構）取代。

questions.stem: A population-based genetic study is investigating the distribution of Human Leukocyte Antigen (HLA) alleles among patients diagnosed with systemic lupus erythematosus. While evaluating a large cohort, the researchers note that certain alleles are significantly underrepresented in affected individuals compared to healthy controls. Which of the following pairs of HLA alleles is widely recognized as protective against the development of systemic lupus erythematosus?

options.text: HLA-DR2 and HLA-DR3
HLA-DR3 and HLA-DR13
HLA-B27 and HLA-DR4
HLA-DR4 and HLA-DR11

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) 中具有保護作用的 HLA alleles。雖然 HLA-DR2 和 HLA-DR3 被認為是 SLE 的一般感受性基因（susceptibility alleles），但流行病學與基因學研究顯示，HLA-DR4 與 HLA-DR11 能夠降低 SLE 的發生風險，被視為具有保護作用（protective alleles）。

questions.stem: A 28-year-old female with established systemic lupus erythematosus presents with new-onset lower extremity edema, frothy urine, and an elevated serum creatinine. A renal biopsy confirms class IV lupus nephritis. Which of the following HLA alleles are most strongly associated with an increased specific risk for developing lupus nephritis in patients with systemic lupus erythematosus?

options.text: HLA-DR4 and HLA-DR11
HLA-DR3 and HLA-DR13
HLA-DR2 and HLA-DR4
HLA-B27 and HLA-DQ2

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查與 Lupus Nephritis (LN) 特別相關的 HLA risk alleles。儘管某些 HLA 分子會增加 SLE 的整體風險，但研究指出，HLA-DR3 與 HLA-DR13 與引發嚴重腎臟受累（即 Lupus Nephritis）的風險有高度相關性。

questions.stem: During a rheumatology and nephrology grand rounds, a speaker discusses the varying genetic susceptibilities in systemic lupus erythematosus. The presentation highlights that the genetic markers predisposing individuals to the systemic autoimmune process can differ from those driving specific organ involvement. Which of the following accurately categorizes the HLA alleles involved in this disease?

options.text: HLA-DR2 and HLA-DR3 increase the general susceptibility to the disease, whereas HLA-DR4 and HLA-DR11 confer a protective effect.
HLA-DR4 and HLA-DR11 are the primary drivers of general disease susceptibility, while HLA-DR2 protects against renal manifestations.
HLA-DR13 is universally protective against systemic involvement, whereas HLA-DR4 strictly mediates severe class V lupus nephritis.
All HLA class II alleles uniformly increase both general disease susceptibility and the specific risk of proliferative lupus nephritis without any known protective variants.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題綜合考查 SLE 中 HLA alleles 的角色分類。HLA-DR2 與 HLA-DR3 是公認會增加一般 SLE 罹病風險的易感基因（general susceptibility alleles）；HLA-DR3 及 HLA-DR13 則進一步增加腎臟受累（Lupus Nephritis）的風險；而 HLA-DR4 與 HLA-DR11 則被證實具有保護效應（protective alleles）。

questions.stem: A 6-year-old girl is evaluated for severe photosensitive rash, arthritis, and glomerulonephritis. Laboratory evaluation demonstrates extremely low total complement activity (CH50) but normal alternative pathway activity (AH50). Genetic analysis reveals a profound inherited deficiency. Compared to HLA-associated risk factors, which of the following best describes the implications of early classical complement pathway deficiencies in the pathogenesis of systemic lupus erythematosus?

options.text: Deficiencies in C1q, C4, or C2 act identically to HLA-DR11 by enhancing immune tolerance and preventing the development of severe lupus nephritis.
They merely serve as a secondary risk factor that requires the simultaneous presence of HLA-DR4 to initiate systemic autoimmunity.
Deficiencies in C1q, C4, or C2 confer a markedly higher absolute risk and penetrance for developing severe early-onset systemic lupus erythematosus compared to polygenic HLA risk alleles.
Classical complement deficiencies primarily impair the clearance of intracellular bacteria, bearing little to no direct correlation with autoimmune disease severity or renal involvement.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Classical complement deficiencies（如 C1q, C4, C2 缺乏）與 HLA risk alleles 在 SLE pathogenesis 上的差別。C1q、C4 或是 C2 的先天性缺乏會導致 apoptotic bodies 或是 immune complexes 無法有效清除，這類突變雖然罕見，但對發病具有極高的外顯率（high penetrance）。

questions.stem: A 65-year-old male is recently diagnosed with systemic AL amyloidosis. Which of the following accurately describes the relative frequency of peripheral organ involvement at the time of diagnosis in such patients?

options.text: Heart > Kidney > Liver
Kidney > Heart > Peripheral nerve
Peripheral nerve > Kidney > Heart
Liver > Peripheral nerve > Kidney

questions.sourceExplanation: 在 Systemic AL Amyloidosis 中，周邊器官侵犯的頻率依序為 Kidney (約50%) > Heart (約40%) > Peripheral nerve (約25%)。因此，腎臟是最常受到侵犯的器官，這與患者常以蛋白尿為最初表現的臨床觀察一致。

questions.stem: A 68-year-old female presents with bilateral lower extremity edema and severe fatigue. Laboratory studies reveal a serum albumin of 2.1 g/dL and 24-hour urine protein excretion of 8.5 grams. Subsequent kidney biopsy confirms AL amyloidosis. Which of the following is the most characteristic initial renal clinical presentation of this disease?

options.text: Isolated microscopic hematuria with red blood cell casts
Rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis with crescent formation
Heavy proteinuria frequently presenting as nephrotic syndrome
Predominantly sterile pyuria and distal renal tubular acidosis

questions.sourceExplanation: 腎臟是 Amyloidosis 最常侵犯的周邊器官，其最典型的初始臨床表現 (initial clinical presentation) 為大量蛋白尿 (heavy proteinuria)，且經常發展為臨床上的腎病症候群 (nephrotic syndrome)。

questions.stem: A 70-year-old male with confirmed AL amyloidosis develops progressive dyspnea and lower extremity edema. Echocardiography reveals a thickened left ventricular myocardium. Which of the following combinations of clinical and diagnostic findings is most highly characteristic of cardiac amyloidosis?

options.text: Dilated cardiomyopathy, low NT-proBNP levels, and high-voltage QRS complexes on ECG
Restrictive cardiomyopathy, significant NT-proBNP elevation, and low-voltage QRS complexes on ECG
Hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy, decreased troponin levels, and normal QRS voltage on ECG
Constrictive pericarditis, normal NT-proBNP levels, and prolonged PR intervals on ECG

questions.sourceExplanation: Cardiac Amyloidosis 的典型特徵為限制型心肌病變 (restrictive cardiomyopathy)。在影像與心電圖上常呈現矛盾的現象：超音波顯示心肌肥厚 (thick myocardium)，但心電圖卻呈現低電壓 (low voltage ECG)。此外，患者的 NT-proBNP 會顯著升高。

questions.stem: A patient with systemic amyloidosis complains of severe dizziness upon standing, numbness in both hands involving the first three digits, and bilateral foot pain. A fat pad aspiration biopsy is performed. Which of the following findings on the biopsy, along with the described clinical syndrome, best confirms the diagnosis and pathophysiology?

options.text: Autonomic and sensorimotor neuropathy accompanied by apple-green birefringence under polarized light after Congo Red staining
Central nervous system demyelination accompanied by metachromatic staining with toluidine blue
Isolated central autonomic neuropathy accompanied by characteristic linear IgG deposition on immunofluorescence
Motor neuron degeneration accompanied by silver stain positivity for intracellular neurofibrillary tangles

questions.sourceExplanation: 該患者表現出自主神經病變 (autonomic neuropathy，如姿態性低血壓 orthostatic hypotension)、腕隧道症候群 (carpal tunnel syndrome) 以及感覺運動神經病變 (sensorimotor neuropathy)，均為周邊神經侵犯的表現。Amyloidosis 確診的黃金標準為組織切片進行 Congo Red 染色後，在偏光顯微鏡下觀察到特異性的蘋果綠雙折光 (apple-green birefringence)。

questions.stem: When differentiating human immunodeficiency virus-associated nephropathy (HIVAN) from heroin nephropathy on renal biopsy, which of the following histological patterns strongly favors the diagnosis of HIVAN?

options.text: Widespread global sclerosis with predominant perihilar hyalinosis
Uniform thickening of the glomerular basement membrane with distinct spike formation
Diffuse mesangial hypercellularity with prominent endocapillary proliferation
A high percentage of glomerular tuft collapse, marked visceral epithelial cell swelling, and minimal hyalinosis

questions.sourceExplanation: 在鑑別 HIVAN 與 Heroin Nephropathy 時，HIVAN 的特徵為較高比例的腎絲球塌陷 (glomerular tuft collapse)、明顯的臟層上皮細胞 (visceral epithelial cell / podocyte) 腫脹，且較少出現玻璃樣變性 (less hyalinosis)。

questions.stem: A 35-year-old untreated HIV-positive patient presents with massive proteinuria and a rapid decline in renal function. A kidney biopsy is performed. Which triad of histopathological findings is considered the hallmark of human immunodeficiency virus-associated nephropathy (HIVAN)?

options.text: Collapsing focal segmental glomerulosclerosis, marked podocyte swelling, and microcystic tubular dilation
Nodular glomerulosclerosis, afferent arteriole hyalinosis, and extensive interstitial fibrosis
Membranous nephropathy, severe podocyte foot process effacement, and proximal tubular necrosis
Tip-variant focal segmental glomerulosclerosis, mesangial expansion, and red blood cell casts

questions.sourceExplanation: HIVAN 在病理上有三大典型特徵 (pathodifferentiation triad)：塌陷型局部節段性腎絲球硬化 (collapsing FSGS)、顯著的足細胞腫脹 (podocyte swelling) 以及微囊狀腎小管擴張 (microcystic tubular dilation)。

questions.stem: A 42-year-old male with a long-term history of intravenous heroin abuse presents with nephrotic range proteinuria and slow progression to end-stage renal disease. If a kidney biopsy were performed, which of the following findings would be most expected, helping differentiate it from HIV-associated nephropathy?

options.text: Widespread glomerular collapse with marked podocyte hyperplasia and prominent microcystic tubular dilation
Crescentic glomerulonephritis with linear immunoglobulin deposition along the basement membrane
Perihilar or global focal segmental glomerulosclerosis with widespread hyalinosis and an absence of microcystic tubular dilation
Diffuse proliferative glomerulonephritis with large subendothelial wire-loop deposits

questions.sourceExplanation: Heroin Nephropathy 在病理上主要表現為周門型或全型局部節段性腎絲球硬化 (perihilar/global FSGS)，並伴隨廣泛的玻璃樣變性 (widespread hyalinosis)。它與 HIVAN 最重要的鑑別點在於，Heroin Nephropathy 通常缺乏 (absence of) 顯著的微囊狀腎小管擴張 (microcystic tubular dilation)。

questions.stem: In the pathogenesis of human immunodeficiency virus-associated nephropathy (HIVAN), specific viral genes directly infect renal cells, leading to distinctive ultrastructural and histological changes. Which of the following viral gene pairs is primarily responsible for inducing endothelial tubuloreticular inclusions and subsequent tubular microcystic dilation?

options.text: gag and pol
env and tat
rev and vif
vpr and nef

questions.sourceExplanation: 在 HIVAN 的致病機轉中，HIV 的特定病毒基因 (尤其是 vpr 與 nef) 會在腎小管上皮細胞與足細胞內表現，這會引發內皮細胞產生管網狀包涵體 (endothelial tubuloreticular inclusions, TRIs) 以及造成特徵性的微囊狀腎小管擴張 (tubular microcystic dilation)。

questions.stem: A 45-year-old kidney transplant recipient is started on a maintenance immunosuppressive regimen containing an intravenous fusion protein. This agent consists of the Fc fragment of human IgG1 linked to the extracellular domain of CTLA-4. Which of the following best describes the primary cellular target of this medication?

options.text: CD80 and CD86 on antigen-presenting cells
CD28 on the surface of activated T cells
CD25 on the surface of regulatory T cells
CD52 on both T and B lymphocytes

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Belatacept 的機轉。Belatacept 是一種融合蛋白 (fusion protein)，由 CTLA-4 和 IgG1 的 Fc 段結合而成。它會與抗原呈現細胞 (antigen-presenting cells, APCs) 上的 CD80/CD86 結合，從而阻斷與 T細胞上的 CD28 交互作用，抑制 T細胞的共同刺激 (costimulation) 訊號。

questions.stem: A 52-year-old man undergoes a deceased-donor renal transplantation. As part of his induction therapy, he receives a chimeric monoclonal antibody that blocks the alpha chain of the interleukin-2 receptor. This medication specifically binds to which of the following cell surface markers?

options.text: CD3
CD25
CD20
CD52

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Basiliximab 的機轉。Basiliximab 是一種嵌合單株抗體 (chimeric monoclonal antibody)，專一性結合至活化 T細胞上的 IL-2 受體 α 鏈 (IL-2Rα，即 CD25)，藉此阻斷 IL-2 的結合並抑制 T細胞增生。

questions.stem: A 38-year-old highly sensitized woman receives a second renal allograft. Her induction therapy includes a humanized monoclonal antibody known to cause profound and prolonged depletion of both T and B lymphocytes, as well as natural killer cells and monocytes. Which of the following is the target of this induction agent?

options.text: Interleukin-6 receptor
CD19
CD52
CD80

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Alemtuzumab 的標靶。Alemtuzumab 是一種針對 CD52 的人源化單株抗體 (humanized monoclonal antibody)。CD52 廣泛表現於 T淋巴球、B淋巴球、單核球及自然殺手細胞 (NK cells) 上。給予 Alemtuzumab 會造成深度且持久的淋巴球清除 (lymphocyte depletion)。

questions.stem: A 40-year-old male transplant recipient previously received a murine monoclonal antibody for the treatment of severe acute cellular rejection. Shortly after the first infusion, he developed high fever, chills, dyspnea, and pulmonary edema. Which of the following targets does this specific antibody bind to, leading to this characteristic first-dose reaction?

options.text: CD20 on mature B cells
CD28 on antigen-presenting cells
CD40L on activated T helper cells
CD3 on the T cell receptor complex

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 OKT3 (Muromonab-CD3) 的機轉及其副作用。OKT3 是一種鼠源性單株抗體 (murine monoclonal antibody)，針對 T cell receptor (TCR) 複合體上的 CD3 分子。它在首次給藥時常引起強烈的細胞激素釋放症候群 (Cytokine Release Syndrome, CRS)。

questions.stem: A 60-year-old kidney transplant recipient maintained on tacrolimus, mycophenolate mofetil, and prednisone presents with an upper respiratory tract infection. He is prescribed a macrolide antibiotic by his primary care physician. One week later, his serum creatinine rises from 1.2 mg/dL to 2.4 mg/dL, and his tacrolimus trough level is found to be remarkably elevated at 28 ng/mL. Which of the following antibiotics was most likely prescribed?

options.text: Clarithromycin
Azithromycin
Levofloxacin
Amoxicillin

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查巨環類抗生素對 Tacrolimus 濃度的影響。Clarithromycin 是一種巨環類抗生素 (macrolide antibiotic)，也是 CYP3A4 與 P-glycoprotein (P-gp) 的強烈抑制劑，會顯著減少 Tacrolimus 的代謝與排除，導致 Tacrolimus 濃度飆升並引發急性腎毒性 (acute nephrotoxicity)。

questions.stem: A 55-year-old kidney transplant patient on a stable tacrolimus regimen requires initiation of an antihypertensive agent for poorly controlled blood pressure. Following the addition of a specific calcium channel blocker, the patient's tacrolimus trough level abruptly increases, requiring a dose reduction of the immunosuppressant. Which of the following calcium channel blockers is most likely responsible for this pharmacokinetic interaction?

options.text: Amlodipine
Verapamil
Nifedipine
Felodipine

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查鈣離子通道阻斷劑 (CCB) 與 CNI 的交互作用。Verapamil 和 Diltiazem 屬於非二氫吡啶類 (non-dihydropyridine) CCB，兩者皆為 CYP3A4 及 P-gp 的抑制劑，會顯著增加 Tacrolimus 和 Cyclosporine 的血中濃度。

questions.stem: A renal transplant recipient is diagnosed with invasive aspergillosis and is scheduled to begin therapy with itraconazole. The patient is currently maintained on a regimen including tacrolimus. To prevent severe calcineurin inhibitor toxicity, which of the following is the most appropriate management regarding the tacrolimus dosage upon starting this antifungal therapy?

options.text: Increase the tacrolimus dose by 25%
Maintain the current tacrolimus dose and check levels weekly
Reduce the tacrolimus dose by 50% to 75%
Temporarily substitute tacrolimus with cyclosporine

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Azole 類抗黴菌藥物對免疫抑制劑劑量的調整。Itraconazole 等 Azole 類抗黴菌藥物是強效的 CYP3A4 和 P-gp 抑制劑，會大幅延長 Tacrolimus 與 Cyclosporine 的半衰期並增加血中濃度。為了預防嚴重毒性，開始使用這類藥物時，通常需要預防性將 Tacrolimus 劑量調降 50% 至 75%。

questions.stem: A 48-year-old renal transplant patient on tacrolimus and everolimus develops severe depression and is started on a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor. Over the next two weeks, he experiences hand tremors and a significant rise in his tacrolimus and everolimus levels. Which of the following antidepressants, known as a dual inhibitor of CYP3A4 and CYP1A2, was most likely prescribed?

options.text: Sertraline
Escitalopram
Citalopram
Fluvoxamine

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查抗憂鬱劑 SSRI 對免疫抑制劑代謝的影響。Fluvoxamine 是一個較特殊的 SSRI，它不僅抑制 CYP1A2，同時也是 CYP3A4 的強烈抑制劑。因此，它會與 Tacrolimus 以及 mTOR 抑制劑 (如 everolimus) 產生顯著的藥物交互作用。

questions.stem: Kidney transplant recipients have a significantly increased risk of developing various malignancies compared to the general population. Which of the following cancers has a standardized incidence ratio (SIR) greater than 5 in post-transplant patients?

options.text: Lip cancer
Breast cancer
Prostate cancer
Gastric cancer

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查移植後的高風險腫瘤。腎移植患者由於長期使用免疫抑制劑，某些癌症的發生率顯著增加。根據文獻，Lip cancer（唇癌）的 standardized incidence ratio (SIR) 大於 5，屬於高風險腫瘤。

questions.stem: Among solid organ transplant recipients, the risk of de novo malignancies is markedly elevated. Which of the following endocrine malignancies is well-documented to have a standardized incidence ratio (SIR) > 5 following transplantation?

options.text: Pituitary adenoma
Thyroid cancer
Adrenocortical carcinoma
Parathyroid carcinoma

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題重點在於移植後的高 SIR 腫瘤。除了皮膚癌和病毒相關腫瘤外，Thyroid cancer（甲狀腺癌）在器官移植患者中也有超過 5 倍的標準化發生比率（SIR > 5）。

questions.stem: While analyzing the epidemiology of post-transplant malignancies, researchers identify several cancers that are extremely rare in the non-transplant general population but exhibit a standardized incidence ratio (SIR) greater than 5 in transplant recipients. Which combination of cancers fits this description?

options.text: Colorectal cancer and Lung cancer
Ovarian cancer and Pancreatic cancer
Penis cancer and Small intestine cancer
Esophageal cancer and Hepatocellular carcinoma

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查在一般族群中罕見但移植後 SIR > 5 的癌症。Penis cancer（陰莖癌）與 HPV 感染相關，而 Small intestine cancer（小腸癌）在移植後的風險也顯著增加（SIR > 5）。

questions.stem: A 55-year-old renal transplant recipient presents for an annual dermatological screening. Which of the following statements regarding post-transplant skin cancers and virus-associated malignancies is most accurate?

options.text: Basal cell carcinoma is more common than squamous cell carcinoma in this population.
Kaposi sarcoma in transplant patients is primarily driven by cytomegalovirus (CMV).
Post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder (PTLD) is most commonly associated with hepatitis C virus.
Squamous cell carcinoma outnumbers basal cell carcinoma, and there is a high incidence of EBV-driven PTLD and HHV8-driven Kaposi sarcoma.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 Non-melanoma skin cancer 與病毒相關惡性腫瘤的特徵。在移植患者中，Squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) 的發生率大於 Basal cell carcinoma (BCC)，這與一般族群相反。此外，病毒相關腫瘤發生率極高，包括 EBV 相關的 PTLD，以及 HHV8 相關的 Kaposi sarcoma。

questions.stem: A 45-year-old kidney transplant recipient, 4 months post-transplant, presents with severe odynophagia, melena, and weight loss. Endoscopy and colonoscopy reveal extensive ulcerative lesions. Which of the following opportunistic pathogens is the most likely cause of these life-threatening gastrointestinal manifestations?

options.text: Cytomegalovirus
Candida albicans
Herpes simplex virus
Aspergillus fumigatus

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 CMV infection 的臨床表現。在實體器官移植患者中，CMV 可以引起嚴重的腸胃道疾病，表現為 Esophageal ulcerations（食道潰潰瘍）與 Colonic ulcerations（結腸潰瘍），甚至可能引發大出血或穿孔等 life-threatening manifestations。

questions.stem: A kidney transplant recipient undergoes an allograft biopsy due to worsening proteinuria and deteriorating renal function. The histology report describes viral inclusion bodies in the glomerular cells and features consistent with a specific glomerulopathy. Which of the following histologic patterns is most classically associated with renal cytomegalovirus (CMV) involvement?

options.text: Membranous nephropathy
Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis
IgA nephropathy
Crescentic glomerulonephritis

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 CMV 對移植腎的直接影響。CMV 可以感染移植腎，產生 Renal inclusions，其在臨床和組織學上最常表現為 Focal Segmental Glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) 或類似的腎絲球病變，並伴隨蛋白尿。

questions.stem: A 50-year-old male, who is 3 months post-kidney transplant, develops asymptomatic elevation of liver enzymes during routine monitoring. CMV viremia is confirmed by PCR. Which of the following best describes the typical clinical course of CMV-induced acute hepatitis in this setting?

options.text: It frequently progresses to fulminant hepatic failure requiring liver transplantation.
It is characterized by severe hyperbilirubinemia and massive hepatic necrosis.
It generally presents as mild transaminasemia that is non-fulminant and responds well to antiviral therapy.
It typically presents with chronic cirrhosis within the first six months post-transplant.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 CMV Acute Hepatitis 的特徵。在移植患者中，CMV 引起的急性肝炎通常表現為 mild transaminasemia（輕度的肝指數上升），大多為非暴發性（non-fulminant），並且會自行緩解或對抗病毒藥物（如 Ganciclovir）有良好的反應。

questions.stem: Regarding the clinical spectrum of cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection, how does the presentation of CMV retinitis in solid organ transplant recipients typically differ from that in patients with advanced HIV infection?

options.text: It occurs exclusively within the first two weeks post-transplant.
It is much more common in solid organ transplant recipients than in HIV patients.
It usually presents as an acute, rapidly progressive disease within the first month post-transplant.
It is relatively rare and typically presents as a late-onset complication, often occurring more than 6 to 12 months post-transplant.

questions.sourceExplanation: 本題考查 CMV Retinitis 的發生時機。與 HIV/AIDS 患者常見的 CMV 視網膜炎不同，在 solid organ transplant (SOT) 接受者中，CMV Retinitis 相對罕見，且通常屬於 late-onset，發生於移植後超過 6 到 12 個月。
